about: Rules for the destructive-call detector. Each api names its hosts, what an unknown request does there, and rules. A rule matches one way (rest, graphql, sql, mcp, git) and says what a yes would let pass. Templates: {name} is one path segment, {name+} the rest of the path, a segment with * is a glob. Paths are matched lower-cased after percent-decoding, removing ;params, empty and dot segments. Extended on 2026-11-25 for Railway, Fly.io, Vercel, Supabase and Cloudflare from each provider's documented surface (research/2026-11-25-destructive-calls-platforms).
